Runtime JSON (core/kg-hub/contracts): code = BizCity_Journal_Pipeline; docs/ is never read at runtime.
source_of_truth: journal-entry@1.2 row: metadata.meta (entry-meta@1) · metadata.resource (brain-resource-link@1) · metadata.learning · kg_source_id; level = knowledge-ladder@1 via BizCity_Journal_Brain_Map::doc_level (one ladder, PHASE-0.129)

read.label: Đọc
read.from: meta.status (pending ⇒ doing, '' with file ⇒ none, '' without file ⇒ na); error = meta.error as 4 fields

vaulted.label: Vào kho
vaulted.from: resource.representations[] has a vault:// ref (last one = ref, rev); knowledge.status stale ⇒ stale; read done < 120 s ago and no ref ⇒ doing; folder = meta.folder

studied.label: Học sâu
studied.from: kg.source_id | resource.knowledge.kg_source_id ⇒ in; learning.graph_state done ⇒ done/graph, pending ⇒ doing/graph; embedded_at ⇒ done/embed else doing/chunks; learning.status failed ⇒ failed

next.rule: read failed ⇒ reread · read none + file ⇒ rebuild · vaulted stale ⇒ restudy · vaulted done + no folder ⇒ assign_folder · studied optional + vaulted done ⇒ study

params.state: step state, or doing|failed|stale as overall when step is absent
params.folder: two digits, optional /slug (same regex as twin-vault@1 folder)

GET bizcity-knowledge/v2/journal/pipelin.result: items[] (pipeline + title · kind · file_name · origin.surface · created_at) · total · scanned (≤ 200 derived) · range_total · truncated · summary{total, by_step, overall, levels} · unread_files · rebuild_max

POST bizcity-knowledge/v2/journal/rebuil.does: BizCity_Journal_Index::request_reread per row (meta.status ⇒ pending, by.op reread); the cell sweep reads them; returns queued · skipped · refs[] · remaining
POST bizcity-knowledge/v2/journal/rebuil.never: a request that walks the whole table (R-PERF)

POST bizcity-knowledge/v2/notebooks/from.who: edit_posts (owner / staff; rows filtered by brain-access meta.read)

body.notebook_id: int? — must be the person's; absent ⇒ a new personal notebook named after the first row's folder or "Nghiên cứu dd/mm"
body.title: string? name of the new notebook
body.kg: bool (default true) — queue the graph pass through document.learn.set L2
body.force: bool — re-learn a row that already has kg_source_id

POST bizcity-knowledge/v2/notebooks/from.does: per row: the latest vault:// Markdown (never the original file, no second OCR) ⇒ BizCity_TwinChat_Sources_Service::ingest type text with metadata.journal_entry_id (the ingest listener opens NO second row) ⇒ learning_status learned · notebook_id · kg_source_id on the row · learning{L1, passages, embedded_at} · resource.knowledge{kg_source_id, indexed_rev = vault rev, ready} ⇒ with kg: graph_state pending + requeue
POST bizcity-knowledge/v2/notebooks/from.result: notebook{id,name} · items[]{ref, entry_id, status: learned|already|read_first|not_found|failed, kg_source_id?, passages?, indexed_rev?, graph?, error?} · learned · skipped

statuses.read_first: no Markdown yet — Đọc lại first (409-like per item, never silent)
statuses.already: kg_source_id set and knowledge.status not stale (force to re-learn)
statuses.stale: knowledge.status stale ⇒ learned again into the same notebook when notebook_id is that row's (D137-8)

ui_words: people see only Ghi sổ · Đọc · Vào kho · Học sâu + L0–L4; chunks / embedding / graph live in the Học sâu tooltip (D137-10)
errors: every failed step carries {code, message ≤ 120, hint, help_code} (R-ERROR-UX)
